lines.zh: 我迈着细长的腿走过干河床。
lines.en: I stride the dry riverbed on long legs.
I peck as I walk, searching.
I trot across the alluvial plain.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在风里竖起来。
lines.en: My feathers ruffle in the wind.
I go around a dead log.
My toes settle on the cracked mud.
I move along the gravel ground.
I check the ground, then move on.

lines.zh: 我一蹦一蹦地越过石堆。
lines.en: I hop over a pile of stones.
I cross the clearing, tail feathers trailing.
I walk toward where the insects are.
I slow down so I don't make noise.
I stop and roll my eyes about.
I change direction and keep going.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挨近那棵树。
lines.en: I approach that tree step by step.
I walk lightly, almost silently.
I stand, my head bobbing.
I raise the feathers on my neck.
I stare at a small hole in the ground.
Dawn is near; I should rest.
I crouch by a tree root.
I turn my head and listen.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等虫子出来。
lines.en: I stay still and wait for insects.
Windblown sand passes over my back.
I peck insects out of logs.
This alluvial ground is very open.
My shadow is thin and long.
I slowly stretch one wing.
Something's moving far off.
I lower my head and keep waiting.
The night is far quieter than day.
I hear every insect in the night.
Standing there, you're too tall.
I eye you with one eye, head turned.

lines.zh: 你手里有什么？我不靠近。
lines.en: What's in your hand? I won't come close.
I ease half a step behind the tree.
The sound of you snapping dry twigs.
My neck stretches and retracts.
I find no insects on you.
Hold still; I can't see you clearly.
I tilt my head and study you.
You won't last long here.
I startle and leap.
My tail feathers splay into a mess.
I dash behind the tree.
This pain is bearable.
My feathers bristle, then fall flat.
I raise my neck feathers and seem larger.
I take a few breaths.
Hide in the cracks of the dry riverbed.
Next night, you'll see.
I can still walk, only slowly.
Are there insects in that?
I poke my head out, then pull back.
Live insects can't hide their smell.
I shuffle a little closer.
Put it down and I'll come.
I peck once and look up.
These insects will do for a meal.
I am guarding the young. Stay back.
I'm not greedy; a few pecks and I go.
Put out more; I'm not full.
You touched me and I sprang away.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，撞一下也没事。
lines.en: I'm light; a bump is nothing.
I dart around your leg.
I hit a dead twig and nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我扑扇了两下翅膀稳住。
lines.en: I flapped twice to steady myself.
A puff of sand rises.
I hide on the other side of the tree.

lines.zh: 碰撞声惊动了远处的什么。
lines.en: The noise startled something far off.
I shake the sand from my feathers.
I steady myself and walk on.

lines.zh: 另一只细腿的影子靠近了。
lines.en: Another long-legged shadow comes near.

lines.zh: 我们在干河床上并肩走。
lines.en: We walk the dry bed side by side.
Its crest is a little higher than mine.

lines.zh: 我低下头，轻轻碰了碰它。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge it gently.
The clutch must be hidden in sand.
We forage together at night.
Two of us beside the eggs.
The wind draws us level.
Our footprints interlace.
Before dawn we go our separate ways.
I peck it up and shake it.
I swallow it whole.
This isn't an insect.
This bug's shell is too thick.
Too hard; I can't peck it.
An empty shell; I toss it back.
It's much bigger than a bug.
Beetles still crawl in the rotten wood.
One small bite, carried off at a run.
I carry it to the tree root.
There are insects in that soil.
I see a small hole.
I head for that tree.
Something's moving, very small.
Movement on the alluvial plain.
I slowly lower my head.
It's right under the root.
Alright — coming over.
I know this patch well.

lines.zh: 腐木下的虫声停了一拍。
lines.en: The insects under the rotting log pause.
I see it; a tiny thing.
This spot is good for striking.
My shadow hugs the riverbed.
I pause and listen.

lines.zh: 树干里的虫子，我先听见。
lines.en: I hear the insects in the trunk first.
I lower my head to the ground.

lines.zh: 原木里的虫子，我再近一点。
lines.en: The bugs in that log — a little closer.
Small as I am, I only eat insects.
It's still in that hole.
My shadow has covered it.
One peck's distance away.
I slowly aim my beak.
It moved; I stop.
All right, once more.
I won't miss this time.
I peck and the soil sprays.
I scratch the sand open.
My beak is sharp and quick.
I whip my head and pull out the bug.
I peck several times in a row.
I beat with one wing.
I hop up and come down.
This strength is only for insects.
My thin claws pin it, and I peck twice.
I lift my head and scan around.
Nothing else stirs.
I swallow and go looking again.
I step out from behind the dead tree.

lines.zh: 牙道赫塔的夜里，我醒了。
lines.en: I'm awake in the Djadochta night.

lines.zh: 沙从羽毛里簌簌落下来。
lines.en: Sand trickles out of my feathers.
I appear along the dry riverbed.
In the dry riverbed, I poke my head out first.
I raise my head to this plain.
I come out of the alluvial ground.
First I sniff the air.

lines.zh: 我轻轻走了一步，又一步。
lines.en: I take one light step, then another.

lines.zh: 这一带很安静，适合觅食。
lines.en: It's quiet here; good for foraging.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在这种光下很暗。
lines.en: My feathers look dark in this light.
I walk slowly to the tree root.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下细细的印子。
lines.en: I leave thin prints in the sand.
I'm here, though you likely can't see me.

lines.zh: 热气一过，我的羽毛都卷了。
lines.en: The heat curls my feathers.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，扑腾了几下。
lines.en: I hit the ground and flounder.
Water soaks my feathers and I'm heavy.

lines.zh: 爆响把我掀得翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我身旁的沙里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the sand beside me.
The light leaves me unsteady.
Finding no insects, I grow thin.
A flash of lightning; I tuck my neck.
No sand here, and no insects.
